rawContent: The #MeToo movement is facing a new challenge: how to grapple with the allegations against Joe Biden without tearing itself apart https://t.co/sGHjLZ7nNC

Tara Reade's account got little traction during the Democratic primary.

But her #MeToo allegation has metastasized into a serious campaign liability for Joe Biden, entering the political mainstream as he seeks to unite a fractious party behind him https://t.co/5JVmTWnY1N

Sens. Kamala Harris and Amy Klobuchar — both potential VP selections — have praised Biden when asked about Reade’s #MeToo allegations in recent interviews.

So has Stacey Abrams, another VP contender https://t.co/5JVmTWnY1N

And Sen. Gillibrand, one of the most outspoken #MeToo movement advocates, was asked whether Dems were contradicting themselves with how they handled Christine Blasey Ford's allegation against Kavanaugh.

“No and I stand by Vice President Biden,” she said
